feedback_driven.quote: After each failed attempt, the agent reads the log, finds the cause, and writes or fixes small programs called tools.

persists_across_tasks.quote: We build the tools on only ten layouts of one seed per task, then freeze them and test them on ten new layouts of the same seed.

data.why_zh: 失败日志驱动修改工具代码，并在新布局测试复用
